text:
claire (product): Heads-up: Product wants to formalize a long-term initiative for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. Target: ship an enterprise-grade pilot that supports per-route region-pin, a clear isolation evidence bundle, and cost-tiered lanes within 3 quarters. Looking for scope, launch gates, and any immediate no-gos.

omar (eng-platform): Agree on pilot focus. Immediate ask: how tight are the SLOs customers expect? We should define 2-3 latency tiers (latency-sensitive, balanced, economical) and map them to allowed fallback rules.

rosa (arch): We need a compact policy manifest (v0) with deterministic conflict resolution. Suggest fields: regions[], tier, allowed-fallbacks[], lock=false. Example: 
```
route("org:acme/chat") { regions:["us-west-2","eu-central-1"]; tier:"latency"; lock:true; fallback:[{region:"us-east-1",model:"quant-small"}]; }
```
Enforcement layer should produce an audit record for each decision (region chosen, reason, cache-hit).

devin (infra): Operational note: cross-region fallbacks => cold KV cache + egress cost. We should require a pre-warm plan for pinned routes with expected token rate > X. I'll prototype an estimator for warmup time and egress cost given a prefix QPS.

hana (solutions): From customer field research: enterprise customers want certifiable isolation artifacts (routing logs, tenant-key KMS bindings, end-to-end attestation). Mid-market asks for a low-cost lane even if p99 is much higher. Regulated industries will require a documented migration/playbook.

matt (sales): Two customers flagged this as top-3 purchase criteria. They want a pilot that shows: measured p95/p99 per lane, failover delta (ms), and cost per million tokens per lane. If we can offer a 6-week pilot with instrumentation, helps deal momentum.

claire (product): Draft launch gates for pilot: 1) Two pilot customers onboarded; 2) Tier definitions + measured SLOs; 3) Migration runbook (shared->pinned) with rollback; 4) Policy manifest + small UI for basic edits; 5) Routing audit export + signed attestations for private deployments. Anything missing?

omar (eng-platform): Add safety gates: per-tenant fallback opt-out and an emergency routing-freeze API. Live policy changes must be atomic and support dry-run. Also need a plan for policy schema evolution.

rosa (arch): We'll add a versioned manifest format and a compatibility checker. Crux: define precedence rules when multiple policies match. Default: most-specific (route pattern) wins, then explicit lock.

devin (infra): I'll run three sims (spiky, steady, bursty) and return a heatmap of cold-cache penalty and estimated egress for cross-region fallbacks. ETA: 10 business days.

hana (solutions): I'll produce 3 customer constraint docs mapping to acceptance criteria and compliance artifacts (1 week).

matt (sales): I'll recruit the two pilots and negotiate instrumentation access.

ops-bot: scheduled: infra/experiment/policy-proto deploy by rosa at 2024-10-15T09:00:00Z

claire (product): Action items recap: rosa+omar policy manifest + enforcement sketch (EOW); devin cross-region warmup estimator (2w); hana customer mapping (1w); matt pilot agreements (ASAP); I'll produce a milestone roadmap + gating checklist by Friday. Please flag any blockers here. :sparkles:
